[Music] Glory be always and forever to God the Father, God the Son, and God the Holy Spirit.
We thank Mother Mary for the grace to come to this altar where she appeared alive.
My name is Jeromin. This is my wife Shency. This is my daughter Jewel Maria. We are parishioners of Thalore in Thrissur district.
We have been living in Abu Dhabi for the past four years. My wife and I are working there. My daughter is studying there.
My mother also lives with us.
Let me first share about the situation that led me to take the covenant. It was on April 12th that we took the covenant online.
What led us to that — I’m a software engineer. I was working in a company without any issues.
But by January 2025, I started facing many obstacles in my job.
My entire division was being changed, and the technologies I had been working with were all being replaced.
Many obstacles came up, and I ended up in a situation where I had to resign. Though it was with great difficulty,
I resigned from my job in February. Even while resigning, I had confidence in my heart —
I had to serve a one-month notice period in that company. Within that one month, I thought I could try for another job.
I had firm faith that I would definitely get another job.
That’s how the situation to resign came about. So I resigned in February,
and March 5th was my last working day in that company. But till the end of March, I didn’t get any job.
At that time, I was relying only on my own merit.
Like how Fr. Joseph, Brother Vijay, the other priests and sisters here always say — we were completely depending on our merit.
At that time, we didn’t give any space for God to work or for Mother Mary to intercede.
I came to realize that. Then on April 10th, I reached a point of deep struggle due to not getting a job.
It became a situation where we all fell into great distress.
On that day, my mother — who stays with me — suggested that we take the Marian Covenant at Kreupasanam.
We completely believed in that suggestion. Back in October 2024,
after Sunday Mass, we had received a Kreupasanam magazine. Whenever someone comes home on vacation,
they bring the magazine from Kerala, and we distribute it among others. That’s how it reached us
Usually, we wouldn’t regularly get the Kreupasanam magazine every month,
but that October, we happened to receive one. My mother had kept that magazine safely in her bag.
She had kept it for about eight months. To be honest, we hadn’t even read it.
We hadn’t read any of the testimonies in it, we hadn’t watched any testimonies either. Even though we had
heard about Kreupasanam while in Kerala, we had never really tried to know more about it,
or tried to understand what the Covenant was. But when my mother suggested taking the Covenant,
my wife and I immediately said “okay,” because by then, it was clear that relying on our own merit wasn’t enough.
We had truly come to feel that. So, on April 12th — the Saturday night before Divine Mercy Sunday — we took the Covenant online.
And from April 13th, we began living the Covenant life. And from that, we received two physical blessings
and one spiritual blessing. The first testimony we received was healing for my daughter Jewel Maria.
Regarding my daughter — every month or every couple of months, she would regularly get fever.
Sometimes every two weeks. If she went to school, the next day she would have a fever.
Fever, then antibiotics, sometimes even hospitalization. This was a pattern that had been
continuing for about one and a half to two years. We had taken her to multiple doctors.
For the past one year, we were going for check-ups regularly every two months. And in those check-ups,
the doctor said that her adenoid gland was extremely enlarged — that’s why she was getting frequent colds and fevers.
And for over a year, the gland was not reducing in size. Every check-up, it remained the same.
But after we started living the Covenant life from April 13th — with daily prayer, Covenant prayers,
scripture reading, and Holy Mass — we entered into that track.
On the seventh day, which was Holy Saturday, she had her next doctor’s appointment.
There’s a reason for that appointment. When we returned to Abu Dhabi after our leave in January,
we had been trying to get an appointment for her since then. For two months,
we kept trying but couldn’t get one. There were various obstacles — sometimes the doctor would be on leave,
or we’d be given a different doctor’s appointment. So many hurdles kept happening.
or we’d be given a different doctor’s appointment. So many hurdles kept happening.
But after taking the Covenant, when my wife tried again, we immediately got an appointment exactly on Holy Saturday — the seventh day.
Right then, we had this inner conviction that Mother Mary had begun her intercession.
We began to realize that something divine had started working.
From the moment we took the Covenant, we had a deep human longing —
to receive a sign. We had seen many testimonies where people saw a rainbow, or Mother Mary’s image in a candle,
or experienced heavenly fragrance. We too intensely desired and prayed for
such a sign. And as a result, on Good Friday, the sixth day of the Covenant,
after completing all our prayers, including the visible (manifestation) prayer, we blew out the candles. After an hour or two,
when we looked at them, we could clearly see Mother Mary’s image formed in one of the candles.
That’s when we understood that Mother was truly about to do something miraculous in our lives through the Covenant.
We had firm faith. My wife believed wholeheartedly. When we were going to meet the consultant doctor again,
she wished for all the tests to be redone — to verify and confirm that there were no issues left in our daughter.
That’s what she prayed for, and as a result, after that image of Mother appeared, the very next day — Holy Saturday —
we met the doctor. The doctor conducted all the tests we had hoped for.
Everything came back normal. The previously enlarged adenoid gland in our daughter had shrunk. Surgery was no longer needed.
Earlier, the doctor had said surgery was absolutely necessary. They had also warned that if this continued,
fluid might collect in the ear, leading to frequent infections, and that it could eventually lead to hearing loss.
We were really worried. But all that tension vanished after that day.
The doctor said, “No surgery is needed now. It’s shrinking.
Just give her vitamin tablets — that will be enough, and she’ll be fine.”
And since then, our daughter hasn’t had any fever or trouble because of the adenoid issue.
This was the first blessing we received. This healing of our daughter was our first
testimony from the Covenant — a divine assignment in our lives.
Secondly, it was about my job. After I left in March, we took the Covenant in April.
After taking the Covenant, I began watching many of Fr. Joseph’s retreats, Brother Vijay’s talks, and several testimonies.
That’s when the phrase “Not by merit, but by grace” started deeply touching our hearts.
I surrendered everything and began to pray. Honestly, at that time, I received a special grace —
a grace to move forward relying solely on prayer. Before that, I had attended many interviews.
In all those interviews, I was mostly depending on my own merit and preparing accordingly.
My focus had been more on interview preparation. But after taking the Covenant,
I shifted my concentration more toward prayer. I began to focus deeply on prayer,
fully surrendered to God, and moved forward with trust in Him. During that time, I had applied to about a hundred
jobs through various job search websites. But from all that, I received only two or three calls.
I also told some of my old colleagues in the UAE to let me know if there were any job opportunities.
Even with all that, I got around six or seven interviews. But in all those interviews,
I was rejected. We began to understand that some kind of spiritual hindrance was blocking me —
something was standing in the way, and it had to be removed. We became aware of that.
In IT jobs, as some may know, interviews can sometimes go up to six or seven rounds.
The hiring company might conduct four rounds of interviews. After that,
the client side may again conduct three or four more rounds. Altogether,
it could go up to eight rounds — some hiring drives are like that.
I remember Fr. Joseph always saying that Mother Mary works in two ways in our Covenant:
either by shortening the time or by making things light. In my job testimony,
I truly believe Mother worked by making things light.
That’s where I deeply feel her intercession. I had especially prayed that
I should not have to go through 7 or 8 rounds of interviews — that I should get a job with just 1 or 2 rounds.
That was my sincere prayer. Also, in IT interviews, we may be asked technical theory questions,
or practical hands-on problems. When all these are involved,
the chances of rejection become quite high.
So I prayed specifically that I shouldn't be asked any practical questions — I should only be asked things I could handle in theory.
I prayed that everything should go smoothly.
And then April passed, and it became May.
In between that time, my wife saw Mother Mary and also Fr. Joseph in her dreams once or twice.
My wife believed that if we were going to receive a blessing like this, Mother Mary would surely give us a sign beforehand. I had mentioned the matter of the candle before —
and similarly, after May 20th or so, one day when my wife was returning after Holy Mass at church,
she saw a few people standing there with an image of Mother Mary.
She went and asked them, “What is this about?” and they responded by asking her,
“Will you receive Mother Mary?”
At first, my wife didn’t understand, but she said “Okay” anyway. They were actually members of the Legion of Mary.
They told her that if we were interested, they could give us the statue of Mother Mary for 10 to 12 days to pray with at home.
After those days of prayer, they would come back and take it to the next family.
Even though we had been going to church for four years, this had never happened to us before.
This was the first time — and it happened after we made the Covenant.
So we believed it was truly Mother Mary’s doing.
On May 24, they brought the statue of Mother Mary into our home.
From that day, we began praying the full Rosary daily before Mother Mary.
We truly believed Mother had arrived and given us the next sign.
Naturally, we assumed that the next blessing would be related to my job.
So we started praying with specific dates in mind — just like we heard in the testimonies.
Since May is the month of Mother Mary, we prayed that by May 31
I would get a job, and specifically that I would receive an offer letter before May 30.
But until May 29, all the interviews I had attended had ended in rejections. Nothing was moving.
By May 29, there were only two days left. And then on May 29, something happened —
Earlier in March, I had reached out to a former colleague about any possible job openings.
That colleague called me on May 29 and said there was an opportunity available.
On the 29th, he said that there was an option. But he also said that although the company he worked for was ready to give me an offer,
it depended on a client interview for the project I’d be joining. That interview could go through one, two, three, or even four rounds.
Only if I cleared that would they be able to issue me the offer letter. So I prayed.
And then the interview itself got scheduled for May 29th itself.
Since we had made the covenant online, we didn’t have any physical holy objects with us — what we had was faith, our Kreupasanam newsletter, and a photo of Mother Mary.
So I kept those near me during the interview and prayed to Mother Mary:
“Please let them ask only questions that I already know. Let me be able to answer them well.
Please make it light-weight. Let there be no extra rounds. No practical tests.”
And to my amazement — there was only one round of interview with the client.
The client was a major company — a multinational airline based in Abu Dhabi.
The interview was just one round — and it lasted only 15 minutes.
Normally, even a single round can last an hour. But this one was just 15 minutes,
and they asked me only four or five questions, and I was able to answer all of them.
And on that same day, May 29, they told me that I was selected and the company would issue the offer letter.
I received the offer letter on May 30.
So everything happened between May 29 and May 30.
Mother Mary takes it very seriously — she gives it utmost importance.
All of this happened within just two days.
These first two testimonies were material blessings.
